about_short_description.short_description: Educato AI is an education technology company that offers and AI driven global platform for exam preparation to underserved students.

product.name: Educato Exam Preparation Platform
product.description: An AI-driven platform offering exam preparation tools including study plans, quizzes, flashcards, lessons, and community support for various exams worldwide.

product.name: Educato AI Tutor
product.description: An AI-powered tutor available 24/7 that offers personalized assistance, instant explanations, and essay evaluation for exam preparation.

identifier.value: BarGraders x Educato AI Bar Exam Preparation

product.name: BarGraders x Educato AI Bar Exam Preparation
product.description: A specialized bar exam prep service offering AI-graded practice essays, IRAC lessons, multiple-choice questions, flashcards, and study plans.

product.name: Residency Exam Preparation Platform
product.description: A platform tailored for medical residency exam preparation featuring lessons, practice questions, flashcards, study plans, and AI tutor support.

product.name: Baccalaureate Exam Preparation Platform
product.description: A platform providing structured lessons, practice questions, flashcards, essay evaluation, and AI tutoring for baccalaureate exam candidates.

product.name: Law Exam Preparation Platform
product.description: A platform for law exam preparation featuring lessons, practice questions, flashcards, AI tutor support, and exam simulations.
